# NWF Strategies

> NWF Strategies (New Way Forward Strategies) builds and operates the strategy, data, fundraising, research, audience, and outreach infrastructure behind high-stakes campaigns.

Electoral politics is NWF's primary proving ground. The firm supports candidates, campaigns, political parties, organizations, and causes across the United States, and applies the same campaign-tested capabilities to public affairs, issue advocacy, and stakeholder campaigns.

Last updated: 2026-08-16.

Core capabilities include campaign strategy, fundraising, research and narrative, political data and modeling, audience intelligence, dashboards, digital programs, voter contact, field strategy, high-capacity calling, peer-to-peer texting, testing, measurement, and rapid feedback systems.

Key company facts reported by NWF:
- Founded in 2020.
- More than 100 million people reached through campaign programs.
- More than $100 million raised for campaigns.
- Work has impacted more than 25 states.
- Voter and donor outreach programs use segmentation, message testing, live response, and feedback to improve resource allocation.

## Documented political work

- [Analilia Mejia, 2026](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/analilia-mejia-2026): More than $400,000 raised through digital in five months with no list acquisition or base-list edits.
- [Abdul El-Sayed, 2026](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/abdul-el-sayed-2026): A $500,000 California major-donor program and more than $1 million produced by relationships built through the program.
- [Donavan McKinney, 2026](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/donavan-mckinney-2026): A national donor network built through introductions, events, bundling, and virtual fundraisers.
- [Will Lawrence, 2026](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/will-lawrence-2026): Monthly fundraising grew from approximately $115,000 to $330,000 in two months.
- [Summer Lee, 2024](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/summer-lee-2024): Receipts grew from $89,989 in Q2 2023 to $1.02 million in Q4, followed by about $920,000 from January 1 through April 3, 2024.
- [Mary Peltola, 2022](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/mary-peltola-2022): Voter targeting, turnout modeling, ranked-choice education, and rapid voter contact supporting Alaska's first Democratic House win in roughly 50 years.
- [Alaska Democratic Party, 2024](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/alaska-democratic-party-2024): Data-driven independent-expenditure work supporting the only legislative chamber flip of 2024.
- [Kansas Democratic Party, 2024](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/kansas-democratic-party-2024): Automated statewide candidate support and 90% faster onboarding.
- [Rachel Ventura, 2022](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/rachel-ventura-2022): A data-first voter-contact program in a primary won by approximately 15 points.
- [Kenyan McDuffie, 2022](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/solutions/kenyan-mcduffie-2022): Targeting, scripts, 113,000+ calls, and 331,000+ texts supporting a citywide coalition.

For a fuller plain-text company, capability, and case-study reference, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.nwfstrategies.com/llms-full.txt).
